user.title: Gicisky 10.2" panel
user.description: Configure the panel driven via the ESP32 MQTT bridge.

write.name: Write to panel
write.description: Render an element list inside Home Assistant and push it to the 10.2" panel via the MQTT bridge.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: List of renderer elements (text, image, plot, diagram, qrcode, ...).

panel_id.name: Panel ID
panel_id.description: Target panel id. Omit if only one panel is configured.

compress.name: Compression2 (QuickLZ)
compress.description: Override the encoding for this call: compression2/QuickLZ (fast, ~45-70 KB) or per-column (fallback, 162 KB). Omit to use the default from the integration's Configure dialog.

rotate.name: Rotate
rotate.description: Renderer-level rotation (0, 90, 180, 270). Leave at 0 for landscape authoring.

background.name: Background
background.description: Canvas background color (white, black, red, yellow). Default: white.

init.title: Gicisky 10.2" options
init.description: Applied immediately -- no Home Assistant restart needed.

data.compress: Use compression2/QuickLZ by default (~45-70 KB push instead of 162 KB)
